quiet.title: Quiet Hours
quiet.description: Reduce encoding intensity during specified hours. Fewer parallel jobs and optionally lower process priority.

streams.title: Plex / Jellyfin / Emby Stream-Aware Scheduling
streams.description: Pause encoding when media server users are actively streaming. Running ffmpeg processes are frozen (SIGSTOP) so they consume zero CPU/IO until the stream ends — no work is lost, the encode resumes (SIGCONT) from the exact frame it stopped at. New jobs also wait until streams end before starting. By default, both transcoding and direct-play streams trigger the pause; flip "Count only" to Transcoding streams if you want direct-play to allow encoding to continue.
streams.summaryTranscode_one: Encoding will pause when {{count}} or more transcoding stream is active.
streams.summaryTranscode_other: Encoding will pause when {{count}} or more transcoding streams are active.
streams.summaryAll_one: Encoding will pause when {{count}} or more stream is active.
streams.summaryAll_other: Encoding will pause when {{count}} or more streams are active.
streams.directPlayNote: Direct play streams won't trigger a pause since they don't use server CPU.
